body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR2521's 90-helper cross-group correction left native phases and frame realization open. This package supplies exact native recipes for its literal word: **934 directed operators cover all 1,689 transports**, including the 279 added occurrences, and all **208 intrinsic endpoint adapters** have rank zero. The full 4,854-event forward composition checks **136,900 coefficients over 370 arbitrary inputs**. The added transport mass remains **810**, and the full mass remains **3,178**.

This is a finite native interface certificate. The 90-helper construction, its savings and the late-exclusive component retain their predecessors' credit. Y0/Y1/Y2 become y+x; the other 101 rows retain G/2. All persistent dirty logical values restore. The eight private copies still have nonzero disposal under the inherited contract. No new helper saving, full supplier, favorable complete moment or kappa is claimed.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.3, Linux, standard library, exact rational and Gaussian dyadic arithmetic.

```sh
python3 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-cross-group-native/verify.py
python3 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-cross-group-native --check-only
python3 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-cross-group-native
```

Primary output:

```text
PASS_P104_CROSS_GROUP_NATIVE edges=934 occurrences=1689 endpoint_coefficients=136900 added_rank_mass=810 controls=8
```

The registered replay passes all three behavioral test groups. It regenerates every native recipe and compares the complete decompressed canonical payload, accepts equivalent frame bases, and passes a Git-free read-only export. Source drift rejects before oracle import; missing evidence/pins, typed receipt drift and occupied outputs reject. Eight semantic controls reject both omitted cross shears, a branch phase-only error, a missing occurrence, wrong child rank, wrong endpoint normal, missing branch raise and missing late capture. The full focused test file ran once at final verification (36.164 seconds), after a targeted equivalent-frame test during iteration.

The original selected source-binding baseline and package metadata/pins pass. No compiler or predecessor circuit producer/package verifier is imported by the ordinary check; the authenticated inherited Gaussian interpreter is reused with attribution. This is not an independent implementation of every checking component.

Not checked: complete inverse-transpose program, replacement of nonzero private disposal, physical source delivery and scalar/address work, global owners/idle/residual invoice, physical precision/tape, all-size admission, selected cold replay, human review or hosted CI.
